findings.evidence: Charts.lean:114-116 `fun x ↦ ⟨euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryParam n x, by simp⟩`; Model.lean:116 names the analogous map `euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryParam`; Model.lean:200 `range (euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryParam n) = euclideanHalfSpaceBoundary n` confirms the image is the hyperplane, not the half-space.
findings.fix: Rename to a boundary-explicit name, e.g. `EuclideanHalfSpace.boundaryParam` (and correspondingly `EuclideanHalfSpace.boundaryProj` for line 119), so the name states what is parametrized and dot notation `y.boundaryProj` is available.
findings.issue: `euclideanHalfSpaceParam n : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → EuclideanHalfSpace (n + 1)` is named as a parametrization of the half-space, but its image is only the frontier `{y | y.1 0 = 0}` (its own docstring says "parametrization of the frontier"). The name drops the `Boundary` token that the merged Model.lean family uses for exactly this role.

findings.fix: After renaming the defs per the previous finding, rename the lemmas to match (`boundaryParam`/`boundaryProj` tokens), so each `_`-separated token resolves to exactly one declaration.
findings.issue: The derived lemma names collide with the Model.lean family in the same `TauCeti` namespace and are ambiguous: `euclideanHalfSpaceProj_param` (Charts:130) vs `euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryProj_param` (Model:168) and `euclideanHalfSpaceParam_proj` (Charts:136) vs `euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryParam_proj` (Model:175) are distinct `@[simp]` lemmas differing only by `Boundary`. Worse, `_param` denotes two different declarations in adjacent lemmas: `modelWithCornersEuclideanHalfSpace_param` (Charts:153) abbreviates `euclideanHalfSpaceParam`, while `modelWithCornersEuclideanHalfSpace_symm_param` (Charts:161) abbreviates `euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryParam`.

findings.evidence: Charts.lean:195-197 specialises to `[ChartedSpace (EuclideanHalfSpace (n + 1)) M] [IsManifold (𝓡∂ (n + 1)) k M]`; Mathlib InteriorBoundary.lean:315 holds the general `isBoundaryPoint_iff_of_mem_atlas`.
findings.fix: Name the model or the conclusion, e.g. `mem_boundary_euclideanHalfSpace_iff_of_mem_atlas` or `mem_boundary_iff_apply_zero_eq_zero_of_mem_atlas`.
findings.issue: `mem_boundary_iff_of_mem_atlas` is a fully model-agnostic name for a statement that holds only for the Euclidean half-space model (conclusion `(e x).1 0 = 0`); it also reads as the general counterpart of Mathlib's `ModelWithCorners.isBoundaryPoint_iff_of_mem_atlas`, which is the general statement.

findings.evidence: Charts.lean:204-206 `e.symm (euclideanHalfSpaceParam n z) ∈ (𝓡∂ (n + 1)).boundary M`, declared without `private` in bare `namespace TauCeti`.
findings.fix: Rename so both tokens resolve, e.g. `OpenPartialHomeomorph.symm_boundaryParam_mem_boundary`, or make it private if it is only a construction helper for `boundaryChart`.
findings.issue: `symm_param_mem_boundary` is public but its leading `symm` token corresponds to no declaration in scope (it is a chart inverse `e.symm`), and `param` is the ambiguous abbreviation above; the name does not identify the half-space setting.

findings.evidence: Charts.lean:92, 100 vs Mathlib InteriorBoundary.lean:305, 315 (`ModelWithCorners.isInteriorPoint_iff_of_mem_atlas`), invoked as `I.isInteriorPoint_iff_of_mem_atlas` at Charts.lean:94; the repo nests Mathlib namespaces inside `TauCeti` elsewhere (TauCeti/Geometry/Sphere/LinearIsometry.lean:30,34; TauCeti/Geometry/Symplectic/TotallyReal.lean:30,44).
findings.fix: Put both (and `mem_boundary_iff_of_mem_atlas`) in `namespace ModelWithCorners` inside `TauCeti`, matching Mathlib's namespace for the lemmas they restate.
findings.issue: `isInteriorPoint_iff_mem_interior_range` and `isBoundaryPoint_iff_mem_frontier_range` are statements about `ModelWithCorners.IsInteriorPoint`/`IsBoundaryPoint` but live in bare `TauCeti`, so they cannot be used as `I.isBoundaryPoint_iff_mem_frontier_range` the way their Mathlib counterparts are used two lines below.

summary: The new half-space parametrization pair is named as if it parametrized the half-space (it parametrizes only its frontier) and collides token-for-token with the merged `euclideanHalfSpaceBoundary{Param,Proj}` family in the same namespace, making `_param` ambiguous across adjacent simp lemmas. Two further names (`mem_boundary_iff_of_mem_atlas`, `symm_param_mem_boundary`) are broader/vaguer than their statements, and the chart-independence lemmas sit in bare `TauCeti` instead of `ModelWithCorners`.
